name: Sloan Digital Sky Survey
notes: external.inspire_experiment is left null: INSPIRE-HEP was not contacted (STREAM_RULES forbid it), so no INSPIRE experiment recid could be fetched.

Structure decision: SDSS is recorded as the programme, with BOSS (SDSS-III) and eBOSS (SDSS-IV) as their own experiment records because they have their own dark-energy results, dates and target samples; they are tied to this record with same_program lineage rows (carried on the lexicographically smaller id per A1). Atlas kind dark_energy_survey is used for the programme because the BAO measurements of SDSS-I/II, BOSS and eBOSS are its headline cosmology; SDSS-V (Milky Way, Local Volume and Black Hole Mappers) is not a dark-energy survey.
SDSS-V also observes with the du Pont telescope at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile; that site is not recorded.

physics_goals.quote: a spectroscopic survey of the approximately one million brightest galaxies and 10^5 brightest quasars found in the photometric object catalog produced by the imaging survey
physics_goals.value: Image the northern sky in five bands and measure the redshifts of about one million galaxies and 100,000 quasars to map how matter is distributed in the universe.

summary.plain: A decades-long survey of the sky using one dedicated 2.5-metre telescope in New Mexico. Its early phases imaged half the northern sky and mapped a million galaxies in 3D; the BOSS and eBOSS phases measured cosmic expansion. The current phase maps stars and black holes.
summary.technical: Programme record for the SDSS 2.5-m telescope survey at Apache Point: SDSS-I/II (2000–2008) imaging and spectroscopy of ~10⁶ galaxies, SDSS-III (BOSS, 2008–2014), SDSS-IV (eBOSS, 2014–2020) and SDSS-V (since October 2020, Milky Way, Local Volume and Black Hole Mappers). Only the early phases and BOSS/eBOSS are dark-energy surveys.

unique_capabilities.value: A dedicated 2.5-m wide-field telescope (3-degree distortion-free field) serving successive survey phases with new instruments, including the BOSS spectrographs used for BOSS, eBOSS and SDSS-V.
